description:
Get a dancer's WSDC profile: current division and points per role (Leader/Follower),
        the Jack & Jill divisions they are allowed to enter in each role, points per division,
        level-up timeline, and first/last competition dates.
name: get_dancer_profile

date.description: When the dancer became eligible for / moved into this division
date.title: Date

points.description: Dancer's current total points in this division and role
points.title: Points

allowed_divisions.description: Skill-level Jack & Jill divisions the dancer may enter in this role (WSDC rules applied)
allowed_divisions.title: Allowed Divisions

division.description: Highest division the dancer may enter in this role
division.title: Division

division_points.description: Points in the current division for this role
division_points.title: Division Points

has_points.description: Whether the dancer has any Jack & Jill points in this role
has_points.title: Has Points

points_by_division.description: Non-zero point totals per skill-level division in this role
points_by_division.title: Points By Division

is_dual_role.description: True when the dancer has points as both Leader and Follower
is_dual_role.title: Is Dual Role

title: Get WSDC dancer profile
